description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 maskfeat: the regions of the features of the wanted types are masked in the sequences of a file (any input format of seqret that carries features: embl, genbank, refseq, refseqp, swiss, nbrf, gff2, gff3; the feature types are those of the vocabulary, wildcards * and ? allowed, several types separated by blanks, commas, semicolons or bars; the default repeat* masks repeat_region and repeat_unit): the residues become the mask character (default N for nucleotide and X for protein sequences) or lower case (toLower, or a blank or no mask character), and the sequences are returned in FASTA (the sequence type of the program is any: every character that is no letter and no * is dropped). Equals the installed program on 1 200 runs (every input format with features, damaged files, the runs on which the program refuses an input or dies by a fault). A5-8c3g, B09 F249.

sequence.description: The text of the sequence file with features (see the formats above), or a sequence as letters (nothing to mask).

sequenceFormat.description: The input format (-sformat); default: the program finds the format.

type.description: The feature types to mask (-type): names separated by blanks, commas, semicolons or bars; * and ? wildcards; default repeat*.

toLower.description: Make the masked regions lower case (-tolower).

maskChar.description: The mask character (-maskchar, one character; none or a blank = lower case); default N (nucleotide) / X (protein).

qualifiers.description: Sequence input qualifiers as typed after the sequence on the command line: -sbegin1 -send1 -sreverse1, -slower1 -supper1 -snucleotide1 -sprotein1 -scircular1, -sformat1 F, -sid1 name, -sdbname1 db, -squick1, -iquery1 query, -ioffset1 bytes.

files.description: More files by name (file name -> text) that sequence may name with a 'format::' prefix.

sequenceValue.description: The USA of the sequence input (-sequence) as the program reads it, instead of the file the text is put in: [format::]file[begin:end:r] (file = the name of an entry of files; the text of sequence is the file 'sequence.dat'), file:id / file:field:query / file{a|b} (id, acc, sv, gi, des, key, org; wildcards * and ?), @list / list::list (a list file of files; # comments; every entry has its own range and format), asis::SEQUENCE; the range qualifiers -sbegin1 -send1 -sreverse1 of qualifiers are applied to the sequences and to their features.

sequenceText.description: The text of the sequence output file (FASTA).

messages.description: What the library printed on its error stream (Warning: ..., Error: ...), in order.

errors.message: Invalid arguments (an empty sequence, a mask character of more than one character, a text no sequence reader reads, an input of an alignment or binary format this port does not read, an input on which the reference program dies by a fault).
